author: GitHub
description: It's Maintainer Month and we're kicking things off with Nicholas Tindle, maintainer of AutoGPT. Nicholas shares how his team stopped fighting AI contributions and started shaping them by embedding agent instructions directly into the repo. We talk about the challenge of knowing whether you're reviewing a human or an agent, why that changes how you give feedback, and what maintainers actually want from platforms like GitHub to make better review decisions.
title: Open Source Friday - Welcome to Maintainer Month 2026

description:
What if your personal planning app could actually think with you? In this video, we walk through how to use the GitHub Copilot SDK to upgrade a basic Node.js application into a dynamic AI-powered assistant. Watch as we generate weekly meal plans, regenerate options based on changing preferences, and build custom weekend activity schedules. We also break down the code so you can build something similar today!

author: GitHub
description:
Serena is a free, open-source coding agent toolkit that turns your AI assistant into a fully-featured IDE-powered dev partner.

It plugs into tools like Copilot CLI, VS Code, and more via the Model Context Protocol (MCP), giving AI agents the ability to navigate and edit code at the symbol level - not just line by line. With support for 40+ programming languages, Serena is one of the most powerful ways to supercharge your AI coding workflow today.

Join us for a chat with AI Researcher Michael Panchenko.
title: Open Source Friday with Serena

author: GitHub
description:
Accidentally pushing an API key or token to your repository can be terrifying. Luckily, GitHub secret scanning automatically checks your commits and alerts you if sensitive information is found. It shows you the exact file and line number so you can revoke the key before anyone exploits it. 

Learn more about securing your code in GitHub for Beginners season 3: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zhxXaFzzJYA

Did you know you can have GitHub Copilot CLI build features for you in the background? We explore how to use the plan and delegate commands to create a draft pull request while you work on other tasks. After the cloud agent finishes coding, we show you how to review the changes directly in your terminal. Watch to see how these three commands streamline your daily developer workflow.
